# Salsa Segura

> A city-by-city guide to salsa and bachata events, classes, workshops, and live music.

## Find events

- [Dance calendar](https://www.salsasegura.com/calendar): Browse dance events by date and city.
- [Boston events](https://www.salsasegura.com/events/boston): Find salsa and bachata events in the Boston area.
- [New York City events](https://www.salsasegura.com/events/new-york-city): Find salsa and bachata events across New York City.

## Explore and learn

- [Discover dance communities](https://www.salsasegura.com/discover): Explore dance venues, organizers, schools, instructors, DJs, and styles.
- [About Salsa Segura](https://www.salsasegura.com/about): Learn what Salsa Segura is and why it exists.
- [Help](https://www.salsasegura.com/help): Find guides for dancers, DJs, venues, organizers, artists, and schools.
